excludedRegistrationFiles: Ten upstream JNI source/header files are reference-only in native-files.json. None of the five registration compilation units is built.
excludedJava: The four mixed Apache/GPL Java registration classes in excluded-java.json are not present in the new API; license identifiers were not merely removed from copies.
newBoundary: Six project-defined JNI symbols under org.ipaboard.latinime; owned handles and packets; no learning, add/remove, save/flush, personalization or gesture API.
retainedCorePolicy: The source core still contains Apache-licensed dynamic-dictionary implementation; selecting the existing v202 file with isUpdatable=false and excluding mutation entry points establishes the new adapter read-only contract. Linker retention is separate ELF evidence.
applicationBoundary: The current GPL IPA Board application and its private experimental English adapter are not distributed as this independent bridge. Synthetic validation results/hashes do not change the host license.
assessment: No unreviewed HeliBoard application wrapper dependency found in these new bridge sources. Dictionary license assessment remains independent and unresolved at file level.
